notes.title: Participation in the Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC)
notes.content:
Doomed Otaku is participating in BIC 2025!
The Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC) is an international indie game event held every year in Busan. Doomed Otaku has qualified to participate and will be showcasing our game there.


Dates ｜ August 15 - 17Venue ｜ Busan BEXCO Exhibition Center 1, Hall 1Booth ｜ C053

notes.title: Doomed Patch Notes V0.4.12
notes.content:
Main Updates
Added English demo

Added Japanese demo

Added judge content

Added a note entry after events


Other Updates
The "Load Game" menu is now grayed out when there is no saved data

Fixed a bug where other characters' affection levels were displayed incorrectly

The first bus stop event no longer occurs after 6 p.m

Added a sparkling effect to the perfume part of the intro

Event images now have borders

Fixed an error where the nickname "Dollstar Jinda" was not visible

notes.title: 2025 PlayXpo Participation
notes.content:
Doomed Otaku is Participating in the 2025 PlayXpo!!

The PlayXpo event will be held at KINTEX in Ilsan from May 22nd to 25th, and admission is free with pre-registration


PlayXpo: KINTEX Ilsan / May 22nd~25th
Doomed Otaku Booth: G71 (HALL 5A) / May 23rd~24th

notes.title: Doomed Otaku - Steam Demo Now Available
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/

Hello! We are KiwiSaurus, the development team behind Doomed Otaku.
The new demo(v.0.3.6) is now available on Steam!
If you enjoyed it, please consider adding it to your wishlist and leaving a comment.
Doomed Otaku demo is currently available only in Korean, but an English translation will be added in the future.

Here are the updated contents.

 ※Update Details※ 

Added Day 2 (Reality) event
Holding the Z key now allows script skipping
Save/Load feature added
Date selection available in save slots
bug fixes
